decisions.reason: The low-pile decorative carpet sits close to the firm's established textile and interior offer, so the firm can read its early results and refine it, and it kept its own page through 2024.

The hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws directly on the firm's material and craftsmanship know-how, which gives it strong absorptive capacity for this product, and it remained presented on its own page.
The corner bench builds on the firm's core furniture expertise, but its move from a dedicated page to a mere mention in 2024 signals weaker visibility and a moderate risk of being dropped.
The low-pile carpet is close to existing knowledge and stayed on its own page, though a sibling carpet (C) was already pruned, which suggests the carpet range is being actively reviewed.
The swivel shell chair line with several models is core seating know-how in which the firm can learn and improve, and it was consistently presented on its own page.
